title: Hold a driving instructor licence
what: Hold the state's driving instructor licence, authority or accreditation before giving driving lessons for reward.

sources.title: Driving Instructors Act 1992 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: 6 Unlicensed driving instruction A person must not act as a driving instructor unless the person is the holder of a licence.
